source_and_permissions.origin: Latest user-uploaded frozen design; original local file was read without modification and SHA-256 verified.

source_and_permissions.rights_note: The reference includes personal catch photography. Do not publish the source image, crops, embeddings, or screenshot-derived photo assets.

visual_direction.background: Bright sky transitions into clear cyan lake water; distant wooded banks frame the central fish-record image, with shoreline grasses visible in the lower corners. Match the current frozen reference's overall luminance and composition; do not substitute a historical reference's background or materials.
visual_direction.brand: Use the registered 渔见 wordmark in deep navy at the upper left and the real profile/avatar state at upper right. The reference has no logo glow or header shadow.
visual_direction.statistics: Three equal text columns display real statistics with thin, bright aqua dividers. Reference sample: divider pixel (349,315) = RGB(76,201,219), #4CC9DB. Keep text in navy and do not add statistic cards.
visual_direction.recent_catches_header: Use a left-aligned deep-navy Recent Catches title and right-aligned All entry with chevron; no drop shadow.
visual_direction.hero: Center the selected real FishRecord in a rounded photo card with a fine near-white outline and a dark translucent lower text gradient. Preserve the runtime fish photograph and actual record metadata; the reference person's image and catch copy are never implementation data.
visual_direction.neighbor: Show only real adjacent FishRecords as cropped side cards, visually quieter than the selected card. The V4 15% darkening overlay is specified in the responsive contract.
visual_direction.capture_guide: Center the static record-next-catch copy between two short symmetric aqua lines.
visual_direction.orb: Use the existing native Orb component with a layered translucent cyan/blue crystal ring, pearl-white center, warm gold camera glyph, local highlights and ambient reflections. Do not flatten it to a solid fill.

responsive_authority.numeric_policy: Responsive and page-local V4 numeric parameters are owned by the single machine contract. The new frozen image supplies appearance targets only.
